precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 9:27
precepts.why:
Peter says to “abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul”, and the two biggest fleshly lusts in the world, going back to Genesis, are food and sex: one deals with nourishing and one with procreation. Paul shows how to fight that war: “But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.” The whole purpose is to bring our body into subjection, in what we take in through our mouth and what we take in through our eyes.

One way to keep your body in subjection: you can control your sexual appetite and your lust by controlling your food intake. The foods you desire, the foods you like, the foods you are tempted with, practice abstaining from them. Take alcohol. The brain stores alcohol with a time and an environment: late at night, social gatherings, partying, celebrating. So brothers that watch porn, try not drinking when everybody around you is drinking. If you can abstain from that, you can abstain from anything else. You are telling your flesh and your reward vectors, even though my brain says drink in this environment, I am going against what my body wants.

Or the candy you love: abstain from it. If you can abstain from the things you love, you gain control and power over the things that have even more control and power over you. You are training your body and your mind and disassociating things from it until you have full control over your vessel.

Then when it comes to sexual temptation, you tell your body, no, I am not associating this feeling with pornography, this feeling with Instagram, this feeling with looking. Disconnect that association, rewire the neurons, and fire them into a different, positive behavior. When you go into that environment, open up a Bible, do something else, and train your brain to associate that feeling with the new habit. There is a way to get complete control over it, so that having preached to others, you yourself are not a castaway.

“Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel.” It is not saying a woman can’t have the outward adorning. Some think a woman has to look bummy and can’t get dressed up. Sisters can plait their heads and get fixed up; just don’t let your glory be in that, because a woman can be all hooked up and her spirit rotten. “But let it be the hidden man of the heart”, meaning Christ is in her spirit, “even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.”

What that hidden adorning sounds like, Sirach tells: “If there be kindness, meekness, and comfort, in her tongue, then is not her husband like other men.” A man who has a woman like this is not like most men, who don’t have it. That shows how rare this spirit is. Some brothers hear that verse and melt, because they don’t have it: do women like this even exist? Ask a sister and she can name twenty things she doesn’t like about her husband, but has to rack her brain for one or two good things.

Meek means obedience. Not always screaming, arguing and fighting, when the man just got through dealing with all that in the street and is the one making sure you have a house over your head and heat; you are biting the hand that feeds you. “For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord.” She adorned herself with subjection to her husband, and that is of great price, far above rubies. Not my lord on the phone with the sisters and cursing him as soon as the phone hangs up.

Beauty is corruptible, the clothes are corruptible; those things fade. A righteous spirit stays with you, and that is how you grow old in righteousness together watching the grandkids. Your inner spirit makes your outside look good. When you find a woman with kindness, meekness and comfort in her tongue, you will have paradise in your marriage and not a prison marriage, because husband and wife is the beginning, the nucleus of everything.

precepts.label: Job 1:10-12
precepts.why:
Peter warns, “Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour”. Job shows how that adversary works. Satan says to God, “Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side?” God had a hedge of protection around Job, and Satan wanted it taken down: “put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.”

God answers, “Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand.” Notice what Satan was given. He could take Job's possessions and stir up his life, but he could not touch Job himself, meaning he could not control Job's actions. The devil does not make anybody do anything. He sets the stage, creates an environment to nourish his goal, and watches; you pull your own strings.

Keep reading into Job 2. Satan “smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown”, and Job sat down among the ashes. Then his wife said, “Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.” Satan did not take control of her mouth. He could not get to Job, so he put the thought in the wife, the weaker vessel, because women give in to their emotions and their own thought process more than men do. She had a decision to make, and she chose to act on the thought Satan put in her.

That is the lesson for us. There are spirits in an unseen realm communicating through our minds. You cannot stop a thought from coming, but agreeing with it and acting on it is your choice. America is Satan's stage; everyone acts in the play, but you choose which script you follow.

precepts.label: John 13:2
precepts.why:
“And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him”. Look at what it says the devil did: he put it into the heart of Judas. He did not reach in and move Judas's hands. He put the thought there, and Judas acted on that thought and betrayed Christ.

This is the same pattern as Job's wife. Satan works through the thought process. He watches, he looks for the one who will receive the thought, and he plants it. Everything after that is the person's own decision. That is why nobody can say, the devil made me do it. You made you do it.

Peter's warning fits right here: the adversary walks about “seeking whom he may devour”. He is searching for a heart that will take the thought and carry it out, the way Judas did.

precepts.label: Matthew 16:22-23
precepts.why:
Christ told his disciples what was coming: he would be betrayed and killed by the Pharisees, the scribes and the Sadducees. Then “Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.” Peter was saying, I am not going to allow that to happen.

“But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.” Christ was supposed to die for the sins of the nation, and Satan whispered to Peter to stand in the way. Christ spotted Satan from a distance, and Peter did not even know Satan was there. That is how crafty and cunning Satan is.

Did Peter have good intentions? He did. But even when good is present, evil is always there. So good intentions are not enough; you have to measure and weigh the words you are about to speak and filter them through the word of God, to see whether this is God's intention or your own desires being worked on by the voice of Satan.

If your mind is not in tune with the scriptures, he can whisper something through your thoughts and take control and manipulate you. Being sober and vigilant means checking even your good ideas against the word.

precepts.label: Wisdom of Solomon 6:16
precepts.why:
Wisdom “goeth about seeking such as are worthy of her, sheweth herself favourably unto them in the ways, and meeteth them in every thought.” The devil walks about seeking whom he may devour, and wisdom goes about seeking those worthy of her. Wisdom has to meet you in every thought.

When a thought comes to your mind, measure it: what is the outcome of this thought? Say you get into an argument with your husband. The first thought says, say this certain word, and you can trigger him and make him feel the way you feel. Those thoughts are being fed to you: say this, say this. Wisdom filters that thought and makes sure it has godly intentions before it comes out of your mouth.

Paul wrote in 2 Corinthians 13:10 that he used his words “according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.” The power God gave us is for edification. With every thought, ask: am I exhorting this person, or could the way I am saying it destroy them? Even good intentions and exhortation can land the wrong way.

It works the other way too. Someone may say something to you that was positive when they said it, but it hits you as negative because Satan knows what you are going through and used that person's vessel. Then comes the thought: why would they say that to you? Say this back. You choose whether to respond for edification or unto destruction, whether to bring contention or to wink at ignorance. Everything is a choice.

precepts.label: Genesis 4:7
precepts.why:
God told Cain, “If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door.” Demons do not simply possess someone; it is a process, and they need a series of yeses. The spirits can only communicate through your thoughts and set the stage. To take full control, you have to agree with the thought, make a contract or covenant with it, and act on it. If you say, I do not agree with that, that is not according to the scriptures, the demon cannot take control of your eyes, your ears, your mouth or your tongue.

Doing well is keeping the commandments. It is a covenant with God: I am not going to watch that, eat that, touch that, taste that. Doing not well, sin lying at the door, is a covenant with death, a covenant with Satan. Satan has commandments too, and any time you disagree with keeping God's commandment, you agree to keep Satan's.

See how the yeses add up. You agree to go past the blood alcohol limit and you let a spirit take control of your body, then wonder why you slept with that person. A thought says, I do not like that sister, you agree with it and start gossiping, and now it spreads through the whole body. You know that food is not for you, but you agree with the hunger pains, the sight of it and the smell of it, and now a gluttony spirit is on you. Every contract with a thought lets the demon tunnel through the five senses to full possession of your vessel.

The answer is in Galatians 5:16: “Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.” Walk in the spirit by studying, keeping a strong unit, sitting at the doorsteps of the Bishop and the Deacons, and addicting yourself to God's word, and you will not have time to entertain the flesh. Stop feeding your mind hours of shows and music that taint your thinking. Reprogram and rewire yourself to develop godly habits, because “the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh”.

Christ is the example. His disciples prayed him, “Master, eat”, and he said, “I have meat to eat that ye know not of.” He was the master of his own vessel: his sight, smell, taste, hearing and thoughts. Nobody programmed him but the Father. “My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.” That should be our agenda: to consume the scriptures, to see, taste, hear and believe them. That is our meat and our life.

thread.label: 1 Peter 5:8-10
thread.text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

precepts.label: Sirach 42:24-25
precepts.why:
“All things are double one against another”. God created good, and he created evil also. He “hath made nothing imperfect”: Satan was not created imperfect. He was created to do exactly what he is doing, walking about like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

“One thing establisheth the good or another”. What establishes the good of us and makes us perfect? When we go through temptation, when Satan attacks us and we overcome and are not devoured by him. Satan does devour some; some brothers and sisters get devoured. But those that are not devoured become better and become perfect. That is why Peter says “after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect”. It is a hard saying, but without Satan, our adversary, we cannot become perfect, because it is his job and his children's job to try us, and as they try us they make us better. Even the real bad things: Job lost all his kids, and that was to make him perfect.

So learn how to fight him and how to see him when he is attacking. See him when he is coming, when he is trying to jump on you and put thoughts in your mind, and say, get out of my mind, Satan. Don't wait until he puts the thought there and you act on it, and afterward you are like Judas, what did I do? That is why the scripture says be vigilant: vigilant means you are watching.

And “who shall be filled with beholding his glory?” Those of us made perfect in trials and tribulation are the ones who will behold the Lord's glory.

precepts.label: Sirach 2:5
precepts.why:
“For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.” That fire, the furnace of adversity, is temptation. Adversity comes from our adversary, and our adversary is that spiritual demon and his children. So the furnace of adversity in Sirach is the work of the adversary the devil in Peter.

Acceptable men are that gold. When an acceptable man goes through that fire, it doesn't destroy him. It makes him better; it purifies him. When Satan attacks and kills and puts in prison, some men it will destroy, and some men it will make perfect in the sight of God. When the ADL and all these governmental organizations attack us, some of you sisters will be up out of here: I ain't messing with them, the government say they a hate group. Some of you brothers will be gone too. But some of you will be purified and become that pure gold.

You have to go through adversity. Your enemy has to attack you; that is how you become better and how you become a better fighter. Then Peter's words come to pass: “after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.” Nobody wants to suffer, but the Lord says if you want the kingdom you have to suffer, and if you are acceptable, after you suffer you will get the kingdom. Suffering makes you perfect, establishes you, strengthens you until you are battle hardened like somebody who has been warring for thirty or forty years, and settles you within your spirit: it is what it is.

precepts.label: Proverbs 30:20
precepts.why:
“Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world.” If you love this place, the love of the Father is not in you. The state of mind of a saint is, I want to be up out of here; I hate this place. All that is in the world is “the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life”, and the lust of the eyes today is TikTok and social media, where the minds of a lot of young brothers and sisters are.

There is a challenge everybody is doing, a dance where they act like they are eating something. The song is called feeling on my body, and it is all about sex. Young brothers and sisters, even among us, watch it and mimic it, and some school sisters were doing that dumb, stupid dance on the new moon. When she says she loves an eater, you think she is talking about eating food? She ain't talking about eating food. She's talking about eating sausage.

The scripture shows what it is: “Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.” She eats and wipes her mouth, and then says she has done no wickedness. That is the characteristic of an adulterous, wicked woman, and that is what the dance is about: sucking rod.

So sisters, you should not be doing those dances. You don't even understand what's behind them. It is the lust of the eyes: you see it on social media and think it's cool. It isn't innocent; you are conjuring demons. We are supposed to be separate, not following the things we see in the world, because the world passeth away, and the lust thereof, “but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.”

thread.label: 1 John 2:18-19
thread.text: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

precepts.label: Acts 15:5
precepts.why:
John is the only one in the Bible who calls a system or a person the antichrist. The prophets spoke of that last kingdom that would fight against Christ at his return, but they did not call it antichrist. John says “as ye have heard that antichrist shall come”, which is future, “even now are there many antichrists”. Anti means against. Even in John's time many were against Christ.

“They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us”. These were men among the apostles who up and left the apostles and their teachings, which were the teachings of Christ, and went out teaching against them. They said the resurrection had taken place already. They taught that you have to be circumcised. That is an antichrist doctrine, one form of antichrist in the time of the apostles.

That goes back to the history in Acts 15: “But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.” The Pharisees were pushing first and foremost that they had to be circumcised after the manner of Moses, meaning the old covenant of animal sacrifice, and not Christ. It is not only circumcision of the foreskin, because that is a law we have to do; it is that they pushed that before they pushed Christ.

So from the beginning there were many antichrists: those who went out from the apostles and taught contrary to Christ. That is why John says “they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.”

thread.label: 1 John 2:26-27
thread.text: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

precepts.label: Jude 1:19
precepts.why:
John writes “concerning them that seduce you”, and verse 27 shows how the seduction comes: “ye need not that any man teach you”. The antichrist is going to try to teach you something. He isn't floating in the air going boo; he's teaching. What do you think all these apologetics are? That is the spirit of antichrist. Does that mean the bishops and deacons can't teach us? No. It is the ones who fell away: “They went out from us, but they were not of us”, and now all of a sudden they want to teach you.

Jude shows who they are: “These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.” There will be those who separate themselves, sensual, not having the spirit of the Lord. How can we prove it? What does the Lord require of us on the holy Sabbath day? So when the spirit rises up in you to stay at home, to play Sabbath sick, to forsake the assembling of ourselves together, whose spirit are you moving in? You see how simple that is. The Lord is about unity; he has never been about separation.

When that spirit rises up in you, recognize it, say Satan is trying to get me, and force yourself past that point. Do you wake up every day on the right side of the bed, everything perfect? No, but you push past it. You don't call off work every day. You still go shuffle the white man's papers, stand by the coffee machine and the water cooler and act interested in the job when you don't want to be there. The hope is that once we are among each other, someone who has the spirit of the Lord can be so infectious that it jumps on me, and I get in the spirit of the Lord.

The gripes and unresolved issues, hatred and jealousy, are what Satan uses as a reason to send you back to Caesar Borgia: he spoke rough to me, he didn't say anything to me. Some brothers and sisters, no matter what you do, you can't make them happy; some are ordained to be that sensual brother or sister. That is why we have to stay in the spirit.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 10:1-6
precepts.why:
Jude says “I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.” He is going into history. When we left Egypt we went into the wilderness, and the Israelites rebelled and were put to death. Who else spoke of it in the New Testament? Paul, in Corinthians the tenth chapter. Write that down in your Bible.

“Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud”. Right here it tells you who the people in Corinth were. They weren't white people, weren't Europeans, weren't natural Greeks, Caucasians. They were Israelites: our fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, not Abraham, Isaac and Esau. Under the cloud: the chariot that followed us. They “all passed through the sea; And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea”, because Moses taught the law and taught us Christ, the gospel.

“And did all eat the same spiritual meat; And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.” Christ was always present. “But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness”: for murmuring, gossiping, sex, fornication.

“Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.” These things were our examples, brothers. That is what Jude puts us in remembrance of: God saved a whole people and still destroyed those who believed not. Don't lust after evil things as they did, and earnestly contend for the faith once delivered unto the saints.

precepts.label: John 3:19
precepts.why:
Jude says the angels which kept not their first estate are reserved “in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.” Has that great day come yet, brothers? No. Those sons of God who went in unto the daughters of men were destroyed in the flood, and those spirits came right back, by way of the three sons, Ham, Shem and Japheth. They are still here today.

John shows what that darkness is: “And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.” Men loving darkness rather than light is sin: you hate God's laws, you hate this truth, you hate the Bible.

There are people like that who were ordained of old to stay like that, the “certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation”. Remember 2 Thessalonians: God gave them up to strong delusion, that they should believe a lie and not repent and come into the light. Some people are bound in that darkness, and there is nothing you can do for them. That is the chains of darkness, reserved unto the judgment of the great day.

precepts.label: Acts 26:17-18
precepts.why:
Christ sent Paul, “Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee, To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light”. To open our eyes, and turn us from darkness to light: from sin to righteousness.

Then, “and from the power of Satan unto God”: from the power of Satan, the prince of the power of the air, his evil communication, those unclean spirits that went out of the mouth of the dragon, the beast and the false prophet. So “that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.”

That is the other side of Jude. Some are bound in chains of darkness, loving darkness rather than light, ordained of old to that condemnation. But the ones Paul was sent to are turned from darkness to light and from Satan unto God, sanctified by faith in Christ. That is the faith once delivered unto the saints that we are earnestly contending for, casting down Esau's lies about fallen angels and Nephilim.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 2:1-6
precepts.why:
“But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them”. This is still going into the same ones Jude speaks of, what Esau calls Nephilim, because they are back today: the evil of our people. “And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of. And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you”.

“For if God spared not the angels that sinned”. This is not literal angels up in heaven sinning against God. They cannot sin against God; they do his will, and when God tells them to do something, they do it. Stop listening to Esau, the pastors, preachers and congressmen talking about demons, Nephilim and fallen angels. That is a lie. This is the offspring of the sons of God. He “delivered them into chains of darkness”, and that is sin, “to be reserved unto judgment”, the same great day Jude talked about. What they did back then they will keep doing today; they are not going to change.

“And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly; And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly”. He destroyed the old world with water and saved Noah and his whole family.

So nobody is confused: Jude is not talking about Uriel having a fight with an angel, uppercutting him, and the angel falling from heaven. That is garbage malarkey. Black folks live by the saying there is nothing new under the sun, and we get that from the Bible; apply the same logic here.

precepts.label: Acts 12:1-3
precepts.why:
“Behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison”. Did the literal devil come and cast people into prison? Did a spiritual demon snatch somebody and throw him in a cell? No. When the Bible says devil, it is interchangeable: it is talking about the father and his children. The same way we can do nothing without our Father and without the Lord in us, these people can do nothing without their father dwelling in them. He uses his children to do what he wants done.

Acts 12 shows who did it: “Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church. And he killed James the brother of John with the sword. And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also.” Herod was a white man, an Edomite. He killed James and put Peter in prison. So at that time the devil casting into prison was Herod, Satan’s children, Rome.

The seed of the devil came back as Esau, and the sons of God came back as Jacob: “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”. Satan means adversary, accuser, opponent: he is the Lord’s adversary and ours, and so is his seed. Devil means deceiver: as he deceived Eve, his children deceive everyone on the earth. That is why we call the so-called white man the devil, because he deceives the whole earth, and Satan, because he is our adversary and God’s.

So know who we are fighting. This is war, and the devil still casts some of us into prison through his children.

precepts.label: Romans 15:4
precepts.why:
Christ told the apostles, “behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days”, and he is telling us today these things are going to happen to us. How do we know? “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.”

You read the scripture say we are going to go to jail. You read that we are going to be afflicted, that tribulation is going to hit us. So wherever you find yourself, when these things happen you remember reading it, and you say, I cannot fight it, this is of the Lord. So you humble yourself to see what he is trying to show you.

That is why you cannot be a snake and think you are going to get away with it, selling your soul for nothing, for a little seventy dollars. The day you are sitting in the furnace of the fire, all of it comes back: the evil thoughts toward your brother, smiling in your brother's face while breaking bread, the things you did in secret against the congregation.

You have your own personal demonic sin you are fighting with. Get rid of that first before you think about lining a brother or a sister up for their failure. What was written aforetime was written so that when the trial comes, you have patience and hope, and you stand.

precepts.label: Psalms 140:4
precepts.why:
Christ said “the devil shall cast some of you into prison”, and “be thou faithful unto death”. David shows who is working against us: “Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.”

The purpose of the wicked is to overthrow your goings. You think Satan is sleeping? There is the spiritual Satan and the physical Satan, and every time they are at work, they are working as a team. He will get in your head while you sleep or get in your head while you are awake. At your job, Satan comes jumping into people, and you see people react some type of way.

This is war. That is why you must prepare your soul for the pain that is coming with their children, Esau's children. Whatever state you find yourself in, jail, about to be put to death, afflicted, tortured, losing an eye or an arm, be faithful, because pain is part of the walk. The body is not you; your soul is you.

Mark 9 shows how that spirit works in us: “ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him”. That is us destroying ourselves in the club, the partying and religion, because Satan is in us and we thought it was the way. So pray to be kept from the hands of the wicked, and ask the Lord to strengthen your faith, because when your faith is weak, Satan keeps attacking you.

precepts.label: Isaiah 27:1
precepts.why:
Daniel said, “And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered.” That time is Armageddon, when all nations rise up and fight, and Michael rises up to fight for us. Revelation 12 is the same thing: “And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon.” It's not talking about war in the sky, as Christians say, Lucifer fighting with God and his angels. It's all nations fighting with each other. This is the time of trouble.

“and the dragon fought and his angels.” Who is the dragon? Lucifer: America and Europe. His angels are his armies. Isaiah proves it: “In that day the Lord with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.”

Leviathan, the piercing serpent, that crooked serpent, is the white man. And the dragon that is in the sea is America. The Lord will punish him with his great and strong sword in that day, the same day Michael stands up for Daniel's people and they are delivered.

precepts.label: Psalms 74:13-14
precepts.why:
“Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.” Remember what we read: “the dragon fought and his angels.” That's what we are reading about here: Christ and Michael and the angels fighting against the white man and his army.

“Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.” The heads of leviathan are all the heads: Europe, France, all of them; America, all of them. Christ is going to destroy that dragon, the whole government.

That is why Revelation says the dragon and his angels “prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.” They don't win against Michael and the angels. When Christ returns, Michael and the angels fight against the white man and his army, and every head of leviathan is broken in pieces.

precepts.label: Isaiah 24:21-22
precepts.why:
This explains the war in heaven: “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth. And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit.” The high ones that are on high are the people ruling. The Lord is going to punish Europe and America, and the kings of the earth too. The gathering into the pit goes into Revelation 20.

Isaiah 34 shows what heaven means. “For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies”: in Revelation their armies are called his angels. “he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.” “And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll.” “For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” Is this heaven paradise? No. This heaven is the governments of this world, and the sword comes down upon Idumea, Edom, the people of his curse.

So the dragon in Revelation 12 is Edom, the fourth beast, also called the Devil and Satan. That war in heaven is Christ fighting with the white man and his armies: Lucifer falling from heaven: how art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer. “neither was their place found any more in heaven”: they have no rulership any more on this earth. And the one “which deceiveth the whole world” is not just a spiritual demon; it's his children, the white man, Edom, Lucifer, that transformed himself into an angel of light.

John says, “I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.” Those two horns like a lamb are the two political parties, the Democrats and the Republicans: two political systems that look gentle like a lamb. But he speaks as a dragon.

That is the politics, the frog that comes out of the mouth of the dragon. And what comes out of a mouth? Communication, and that communication is propaganda, persuasion and lies. These are “the spirits of devils”, and they do not stay at home: they “go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world”, gathering them “to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.”

precepts.label: Revelation 13:16-17
precepts.why:

On a large scale that is trade between nations, but it is also the regular buying and selling of everyday life. That is why they are trying to do away with the currency as it is now and bring everything into a digital system: to monitor God's people who speak up against this society.

precepts.label: Revelation 22:8-9
precepts.why:
John says it twice. In Revelation 19 he fell at the angel's feet, and here again: “I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.”

And the angel says the same thing again: “See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.” He will not take worship, because he is not God. He is a fellowservant, one of the brethren.

That is who the angels are: our brothers. They are not demons. They ate with Lot because they have mouths just like us, and they were going to lie down because they look like us. Esau calls them humanoids, and to Esau they are going to be some demons, but those are our brothers. The angels have tribes too, and in Revelation 21, do not be surprised if the angels standing at the twelve gates are each standing at the gate of their own tribe.

precepts.label: Tobit 5:12-14
precepts.why:
Here Raphael, before he makes himself known, presents himself to Tobit another way: “I am Azarias, the son of Ananias the great, and of thy brethren.” An angel of God naming himself as one of the brethren, just as the angel told John, “I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren.”

Tobit answers, “Thou art welcome, brother; be not now angry with me, because I have enquired to know thy tribe and thy family; for thou art my brother, of an honest and good stock.” Tobit asks after his tribe and his family, and receives him as a brother.

He knows his people: “I know Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias, as we went together to Jerusalem to worship, and offered the firstborn, and the tenths of the fruits; and they were not seduced with the error of our brethren: my brother, thou art of a good stock.”

So the angel who walked with Tobit's son was taken for an Israelite brother, of a tribe and a family. That is how close the angels are to us: they look like us, they have tribes too, and they are our brethren.

precepts.label: Tobit 12:15
precepts.why:
Now Raphael makes himself known: “I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.” The one Tobit called brother, Azarias of his brethren, was the angel all along.

Why do the angels present the prayers of the saints? Because they minister unto us. They are ministering spirits working on our behalf, because those are our brothers.

They are not demonic spirits sent here to oppose the people that inhabit this place called the United Snakes of America. That is untrue. That is popular persuasion; that is lies. The world is being taught to call what comes out of the heavens demons and fallen angels, so that it will gather to fight against Christ and his army. But the angels are our brethren, fellowservants who keep the testimony of Jesus, and we worship God alone.

precepts.label: Isaiah 47:3
precepts.why:
The armies in heaven follow Christ “upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.” That fine linen, white and clean, is the immortal body. To prove it, go to Isaiah, speaking to Babylon: “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.”

Christ said he is going to take vengeance, and he will not meet Babylon as a man. Christ is coming back with that immortal body. You will not be able to nail him back to the cross like you did in Jerusalem.

That is what the white horse and the fine linen, white and clean, make reference to. And he comes to make war, because God is a man of war: “in righteousness he doth judge and make war.” His vesture is dipped in blood, because there is going to be a lot of bloodshed, a lot of killing. On his head are many crowns, because he is going to take everyone's crowns and be the one King, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”

precepts.label: Wisdom of Solomon 5:1-6
precepts.why:
Revelation says the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies were gathered together to make war against him that sits on the horse. Wisdom shows what happens when they see him: “Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him, and made no account of his labours.” That is us, the Israelites, standing before Esau and the nations, who made no account of our labours here.

“When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear, and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation, so far beyond all that they looked for.” The strangeness of his salvation is the chariots, us being taken up. That is going to be strange and foreign to them. They will no longer talk about the deliverance out of Egypt, but about the new deliverance from the land of the north. A black God, a black Christ, coming to redeem his black people: that is going to be the new talk of the town.

“And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach.” Christ is going to put it in their mind: these are the people you afflicted, raped, robbed, murdered and enslaved. These are my people.

“We fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour: How is he numbered among the children of God, and his lot is among the saints! Therefore have we erred from the way of truth.”

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 13:1-11
precepts.why:
Revelation says the armies were gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse and against his army. Ezra saw that same war. “there arose a wind from the sea”, and “that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven: and when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled.” The man that came out of the sea is Christ, with the thousands of heaven, the armies that follow him.

And “whensoever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice, like as the earth faileth when it feeleth the fire.” He speaks the laws out of his mouth, and the people just disintegrate, because they are guilty of that law. That is the sharp sword out of his mouth in Revelation, the laws of God.

Then “there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea”. They will have one consent, because the Most High is going to harden them like he did Pharaoh. And the popular persuasion is already laying the groundwork: let's all come together and fight the demons coming from space.

After this, “all they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.” Scared to death, but the Most High moves them. As Romans 9 shows, he built them up, just like ancient Egypt: Babylon the Great, this white man, this Edomite, built up just to be destroyed, made to fight against him.

And “he neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war”, but sent out of his mouth “a blast of fire”, “a flaming breath”, and “sparks and tempests”, and “burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke.” Ashes to ashes, and dust to dust.

precepts.label: Numbers 24:17
precepts.why:
Christ says, “I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.” So who is the morning star? Christ is the morning star. Then why is Lucifer called “son of the morning”? The King James is the only version with Lucifer there, because the scholars who translated it understood something everybody else did not: there is a difference between that morning star and the morning star we read about all through the scriptures.

Balaam saw the true star: “I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob”. A star out of who? Out of Jacob. Did it say out of Esau? No: out of Jacob.

“and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel”: a ruler shall rise out of Israel. “and shall smite the corners of Moab”, the Moabites, the Chinese, “and destroy all the children of Sheth.”

So the star in the scriptures is Christ, the ruler rising out of Israel, the offspring of David. The star comes out of Jacob, not Esau, and that is how we know the one called Lucifer, the false morning star, is a different one.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 1:19
precepts.why:
“We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts”. So you see who is referred to as the star, the bright morning star: Christ, the day star that arises in your hearts.

Then why is the king of Babylon, America, referred to as Lucifer? Because “such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.” “And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.” The white man came and taught another Christ and transformed himself into an apostle of Christ. America transformed itself in the 1950s into a God-loving Christian nation, and for the last seventy years has pushed that it is here to set up righteousness and justice on the earth, after murdering, stealing, colonizing and enslaving millions of people.

That is why Isaiah calls him “Lucifer, son of the morning”: he says he is Christian, righteous, the light, and makes himself look like the morning star. But Christ is the real morning star, “the true Light”, and the day star Peter speaks of arises in the hearts of those who take heed to the sure word of prophecy.

precepts.label: Sirach 37:27-31
precepts.why:
“Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent: for if thou comest too near it, it will bite thee.” We usually use flee for lust, but you cannot flee from something that is in your refrigerator or your freezer. The brain does not distinguish: the same dopamine and reward centers fire for food that pleases the flesh as for sex. Flee from the unhealthy foods, or they bite you and destroy you. That is why so many brothers have health issues, in the hospital every week and unable to make the Sabbath. You need a healthy vessel to do the work.

Sirach goes further: “My son, prove thy soul in thy life, and see what is evil for it, and give not that unto it.” From verse 27 down to 30 it is literally about food, and spiritually it is about proving your spirit. Just as you see which foods make you sick and unhealthy, see what things are evil for you and make you mentally unhealthy, and give not that unto it. Spartacus was a good show, with a whole lot of sex scenes; you may have to say, I can’t watch this.

“For all things are not profitable for all men, neither hath every soul pleasure in every thing.” A fat brother’s diet is different from a slim officer’s. “Be not unsatiable in any dainty thing, nor too greedy upon meats: For excess of meats bringeth sickness, and surfeiting will turn into choler.” Don’t overindulge beyond your limits, and don’t eat excessively.

Food porn works on the brain the same way pornography does, because the brain sees both as nourishment. There is a healthy pleasure and an unhealthy one: healthy food instead of junk, your wife instead of the screen. Peter says, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul. When you are counting calories and a 240-calorie cookie calls you with 100 left, you feel that war inside. It is the same temptation, a worldly lust we inherited through America.

“By surfeiting have many perished; but he that taketh heed prolongeth his life.” The Lord is putting us on another level of discipline, because we need brothers fit and in the street teaching.
